website_summary.name: HackerNews Clone Interface
website_summary.description: The website presents a sleek, dark-themed interface designed to mimic the functionality of Hacker News, featuring interactive buttons and a clean layout for story management.
website_summary.appearance: The website adopts a minimalist and modern design with a dark background and orange accents. At the top, there's a header containing the site logo ("Hacker News Clone") alongside functional buttons for toggling light/dark mode, viewing favorites, and hiding read stories. Below the header, a search bar allows users to filter stories. The main content area displays a section titled "Top Stories," which currently indicates no stories match the filters. A "More Stories" button is centrally placed below this section. At the bottom, an "About" section provides details about the website's purpose and capabilities, including a bulleted list of features.
website_summary.functionality:
The website includes several key functionalities: 
- A search bar enables users to find specific stories by entering keywords.
- Buttons allow users to toggle between light and dark modes, view only their favorite stories, and hide stories they've already read.
- Users can load additional stories using the "More Stories" button.
- The "About" section outlines the website's capabilities, such as favoriting, hiding, marking stories as read, voting on stories, filtering stories, and switching display modes.

functionality_testing.name: Filter Stories Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the filtering mechanism is not preventing additional stories from loading when the More Stories button is clicked.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The page is loaded with the initial set of stories.
functionality_testing.expected_results: Additional stories should be visible after clicking the button, provided there are no active filters preventing them from loading. 7. Next Steps : Investigate the filtering mechanism to determine if it is preventing the stories from loading. If filters are active, disable them and click the "More Stories" button again.
procedure: Click on the Filter stories button to access the filtering options.
Check if there are any active filters that might be preventing the stories from loading.
If filters are active, disable them.
Click the More Stories button again.
Verify that additional stories are loaded and displayed below the existing ones.

functionality_testing.name: Light/Dark Mode Toggle Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Light/Dark Mode Toggle button switches the theme consistently.
functionality_testing.preconditions: Page is loaded in dark mode.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The page should switch themes consistently without disrupting the layout or color scheme.
procedure: Click on the Light/Dark Mode Toggle button.
Verify that the theme switches to light mode.
Click the button again to switch back to dark mode.

functionality_testing.name: More Stories Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the More Stories button loads additional stories.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The page is loaded with the initial set of stories.
functionality_testing.expected_results: Additional stories should be visible after clicking the button. 7. Next Steps : Click the "More Stories" button to load additional stories.
procedure: Click on the More Stories button.
Verify that additional stories are loaded and displayed below the existing ones.

functionality_testing.name: Search Bar Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the search bar correctly filters stories based on user input using Search stories...
functionality_testing.preconditions: The search bar is visible and ready for input.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The "Top Stories" section should display stories matching the entered keyword. 7. Next Steps : Enter a keyword into the search bar to test its functionality.
procedure: Type a keyword related to a known story into the search bar.
Verify that the "Top Stories" section updates to display stories matching the entered keyword.

functionality_testing.name: Sun Icon Button Test
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that clicking the Sun Icon Button toggles the theme from dark to light mode.
functionality_testing.preconditions: The website is currently in dark mode.
functionality_testing.expected_results: The website should transition to light mode, altering background, text, and button colors accordingly. 7. Next Steps : Click the sun icon button to toggle the theme to light mode.
procedure: Click on the Sun Icon Button.
Observe the change in background and text colors.

functionality_testing.name: Test Favorites Button Functionality
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Favorites Button correctly displays the user's favorite stories.
functionality_testing.coverage_element: Favorites Button : Button for accessing favorite stories
functionality_testing.preconditions: User is logged in and has at least one story marked as favorite.
functionality_testing.expected_results: Upon clicking the Favorites Button, the page should display a list of the user's favorite stories.
procedure: Step 1 : Click on the Favorites Button in the header.
Step 2 : Verify that the list of favorite stories is displayed.

functionality_testing.name: Test Hide Read Button Functionality
functionality_testing.objective: To verify that the Hide Read Button correctly hides stories that have been read by the user.
functionality_testing.coverage_element: Hide Read Button : Button for hiding read stories
functionality_testing.preconditions: User is logged in and has marked at least one story as read.
functionality_testing.expected_results: Upon clicking the Hide Read Button, all stories marked as read should be hidden from the list.
procedure: Step 1 : Click on the Hide Read Button in the header.
Step 2 : Verify that all read stories are hidden from the list.

data_display_testing.name: Top Stories Card Display Test
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the Top Stories Card displays content accurately.
data_display_testing.preconditions: Filters are set to show no stories.
data_display_testing.expected_results: The card should display the message accurately and maintain proper alignment. 7. Next Steps : Scroll down to inspect the alignment and consistency of UI elements further down the page.
procedure: Hover over the Top Stories Card.
Verify that the message "No stories match your filters." is displayed correctly.

data_display_testing.name: Test Search Input Data Display
data_display_testing.objective: To verify that the Search Input correctly filters and displays stories based on the user's search query.
data_display_testing.coverage_element: Search Input : Textbox for searching stories
data_display_testing.preconditions: The search bar is accessible and there are stories available to search.
data_display_testing.expected_results: Upon entering a search query and submitting, the page should display only the stories that match the query.
procedure: Step 1 : Enter a specific search term in the Search Input textbox.
Step 2 : Press Enter or click the search icon to submit the query.
Step 3 : Verify that only stories matching the search term are displayed.

procedure: Observe the specified UI elements and their design properties.
